title: Probe-limit HHH optical conductivity and superfluid density
summary: An independently cross-checked spectral and Riccati reproduction of the exact normal optical conductivity and the dimension-two HHH near-critical superfluid-density coefficient.

source.title: Building an AdS/CFT superconductor
equation_refs: Figure 1 right-panel condensate reproduction inherited from the protected benchmark
Figure 2 right panel retained as a documented non-reproduction

conventions.name: background and coordinate
conventions.value: Planar AdS4-Schwarzschild probe limit; u = r_h/r in [0,1], F(u) = 1-u^3, L = r_h = 1 during the dimensionless solve
conventions.rationale: Uses the protected dimension-two HHH background and finite radial interval.

conventions.name: quantization and sources
conventions.value: m^2 L^2 = -2, q = 1, Delta = 2, psi_- = 0; A_x = A_0 + A_1 u + ... with unit optical source A_0
conventions.rationale: Separates the vanishing scalar source from the applied transverse gauge-field source.

conventions.name: retarded response
conventions.value: delta A_x proportional to exp(-i omega t), with A_x = (1-u)^(-i Omega/3) a(u) and regular a at the horizon
conventions.rationale: Fixes the retarded sign and ingoing horizon branch.

conventions.name: frequency and conductivity
conventions.value: omega/T = 4 pi Omega/3 and sigma(omega) = -i A_1/(Omega A_0)
conventions.rationale: Matches the source radial coordinate and boundary current convention.

conventions.name: static London normalization
conventions.rationale: Equals the zero-frequency limit of (omega/T)(T/T_c) Im sigma.

parameters.name: scalar mass squared
parameters.description: Mass defining the two AdS4 scalar falloffs.

parameters.name: scalar charge
parameters.description: Fixed by the source field-rescaling convention.

parameters.name: near-critical temperatures
parameters.description: Frozen asymptotic window used for the C_2 and C_4 fit.

parameters.name: near-critical spectral degrees
parameters.description: Refinement, primary, and audit degrees chosen before the corrected run.

equations.description: Zero-momentum transverse Maxwell response on the protected HHH condensed background.
equations.source_ref: Hartnoll et al., arXiv:0803.3295v1, Eq. (13), transformed to u = r_h/r.

equations.description: Zero-frequency London equation with regular horizon condition A_x'(1) + 2 psi_h^2 A_x(1)/3 = 0.
equations.source_ref: Zero-frequency limit of source Eq. (13), cross-checked against Hartnoll et al., arXiv:0810.1563, Sec. IV.

equations.expression: n_s/T_c = C_2 delta + C_4 delta^2, delta = 1-T/T_c
equations.description: Asymptotic fit retaining the leading nonlinear correction rather than forcing a finite window onto one line.
equations.source_ref: Source statement n_s approximately C_2 (T_c-T) as T approaches T_c, with C_2 = 24 for Delta = 2.

observables.name: complex optical conductivity
observables.extraction: UV source/current ratio -i A_1/(Omega A_0), independently computed by spectral series transfer and Riccati DOP853.

observables.name: near-critical superfluid-density coefficient
observables.extraction: Static London densities are fit to C_2 delta + C_4 delta^2; finite-frequency pole intercepts provide an independent coefficient.

acceptance_criteria: The protected HHH condensate verifier passes unchanged.
The exact normal-state conductivity equals one within 1e-8.
Every near-critical N=160 and N=192 independent equation residual is below the unchanged 1e-6 ceiling.
Spectral and Riccati conductivities agree within 5e-4, and static London densities agree with finite-frequency pole intercepts within 5e-4.
The asymptotic static coefficient agrees with C_2 = 24 within 15 percent and remains stable within 10 percent after the frozen temperature omission.
The inherited Figure 1 low-temperature condensate scale stays within 8.2 to 8.7; Figure 2 has no acceptance role.

tests.expected: The exact normal response, near-critical coefficient, independent routes, residuals, and preserved non-reproduction evidence pass their declared gates.
The previously released onset, Figure 1 condensate curve, and cutoff-refinement checks pass unchanged.
The N=128,160,192 ladder, UV-window refinement, and static/pole comparison satisfy unchanged gates.

claims.statement: For Delta = 2, the source gives an exact normal-state optical conductivity and a near-critical superfluid-density coefficient C_2 = 24.
claims.evidence: Hartnoll, Herzog, and Horowitz, arXiv:0803.3295v1, Eqs. (13)-(19) and the near-critical discussion.

claims.statement: HoloForge reproduces the exact normal response and obtains C_2 = 23.96884335 from the static London route, with an independent finite-frequency value 23.96883307 under the declared convergence gates.
claims.evidence: Owner-approved bounded verifier, focused tests, static/pole route agreement, and N=128,160,192 convergence record.

limitations: The calculation neglects matter backreaction on the metric and is not a controlled zero-temperature solution.
The boundary U(1) is global unless an additional weak gauging prescription is supplied; charged superfluid is then the more precise interpretation.
The public rightmost Figure 2 curve is not reproduced and remains provenance-only; no source overlay or relabelled target is generated.
The benchmark is restricted to zero spatial momentum, positive frequencies, the Delta = 2 quantization, and the declared near-critical window.
The direct real-part delta distribution, sum rule, free energy, quasinormal modes, backreaction, and nonlinear transport are outside scope.
Agreement within the HHH model is not empirical validation of a material or a microscopic pairing mechanism.
